mapper.select: SELECT mission.id AS mission_id, mission.mission_title, mission.mission_content, mission.mission_type, category.id AS category_id, parent_category.category_name AS parent_category_name, category.category_name, assignment.assign_date, difficulty.difficulty_name, assignment.target_rate, assignment.base_amount, assignment.target_value, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN today_transaction.is_refund = 1 THEN -COALESCE(today_transaction.refunded_amount, today_transaction.amount) ELSE today_transaction.amount END ) FROM tbl_transaction today_transaction WHERE today_transaction.user_id = assignment.user_id AND today_transaction.category_id = mission.category_id AND today_transaction.tr_date = assignment.assign_date AND today_transaction.classification = 'CONSUMPTION' AND today_transaction.direction = 'OUT' AND today_transaction.is_excluded_from_summary = 0 ), 0) AS current_amount, assignment.result, assignment.assignment_reason FROM tbl_user_mission_info assignment JOIN tbl_mission_pool mission ON mission.id = assignment.mission_id JOIN tbl_category category ON category.id = mission.category_id JOIN tbl_category parent_category ON parent_category.id = category.parent_id LEFT JOIN tbl_mission_difficulty difficulty ON difficulty.id = assignment.difficulty_id WHERE assignment.user_id = #{userId} AND assignment.assign_date = #{assignDate}
